intro.description: Documents from other tools often break a rule of their standard. Hermes 2 opens them anyway, shows the problems and repairs what it can automatically. The samples/invalid folder of the installation has a broken record to practice on.

item.title: Open the document
item.description: Open the document (Ctrl+O). A file that is not well-formed XML opens on the XML page with its original text, so that you can repair it there.

item.title: See the problems
item.description: The Problems view lists every problem with its location; double-click one to go to the field.

item.title: Apply the quick fixes
item.description: Select a problem and press Ctrl+1 (or Quick Fix in its context menu). In the Quick Fix dialog, Select All applies the same fix to every problem of its kind, in all documents. Problems that need your input (a description, a disclosure) lead you to the field.

item.title: Review the changes
item.description: Compare the document with its saved version to see, field by field, what the fixes changed before you save.
item.onCompletion: Save the document (Ctrl+S). To repair many files from the command line, use hermes fix.
